review_method: Each full-resolution frame was inspected on creation, then all nine accepted scenes were reviewed chronologically on automation/production-work/ollie-otter-floating-picnic-01/asset-contact-sheet.png.

Jug alone on the right balances basket and blanket on the left; both rims read level.
Willa boards first while low and secures the right jug; Ollie secures the left basket and Fern remains dockside.
All three friends remain low on the centre line, cargo stays strapped opposite and the dock ropes remain visible.
Fern stays fully inside at the left inner rim; Ollie gives a calm cue and strapped cargo remains fixed.
Fern is visibly centred, the balance token is level and opposite shallow paddle strokes restore symmetry.
Ollie and seated Willa support the basket hand-to-hand while Fern waits on shore and the raft remains tied.
